title: Sousou no Frieren
synopsis: During their decade-long quest to defeat the Demon King, the members of the hero's party forge bonds through adventures and battles. As the years pass, Frieren gradually realizes how her days in the party truly impacted her.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
synopsis: After a horrific alchemy experiment goes wrong, brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric set off on a quest to restore their bodies by locating the Philosopher's Stone.

title: Steins;Gate
synopsis: Eccentric scientist Rintarou Okabe discovers his invention can send messages into the past, leading him into a dangerous battle to protect his loved ones and preserve the timeline.

title: Hunter x Hunter (2011)
synopsis: Gon Freecss aims to become a Hunter to find his father, befriending Kurapika, Leorio, and Killua as they venture into a perilous world together.

title: Gintama
synopsis: In an alternate Edo ruled by aliens, Gintoki Sakata and his Yorozuya team take on odd jobs, encountering everything from alien royalty to local gang scuffles.

title: Gintama°
synopsis: Gintoki, Shinpachi, and Kagura return as the fun-loving but broke members of the Yorozuya team, facing both hilarious misadventures and dangerous crises.

title: Gintama: The Final
synopsis: The Yorozuya and their allies unite for one final battle to save Edo, fulfilling the wishes of their teacher and reliving their pasts one last time.

title: Ginga Eiyuu Densetsu
synopsis: A 150-year stalemate between two interstellar powers ends as two brilliant leaders, Reinhard and Yang Wenli, rise to reshape the fate of humanity.

title: Gintama'
synopsis: Shinpachi returns to Edo to find everyone bizarrely changed, embarking on a quest with the Shinsengumi to restore the city to how he remembers it.

title: Gintama': Enchousen
synopsis: Gintoki must reclaim his rightful place from his golden-haired doppelganger Kintoki, while the Yorozuya help an elderly courtesan find her long-lost love.

title: Shingeki no Kyojin Season 3 Part 2
synopsis: The Survey Corps returns to Shiganshina to retake Wall Maria, uncovering long-hidden secrets in the Yeager family's basement.

title: Bleach: Sennen Kessen-hen
synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki and his allies face Yhwach, an ancient Quincy king seeking to erase both the human world and the Soul Society for good.

title: Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Ultra Romantic
synopsis: The elite student council of Shuchiin Academy continues their competitive battle of wits, each trying to trick the other into confessing love first.

title: Fruits Basket: The Final
synopsis: Tooru Honda is determined to break the curse binding the Souma family, despite the emotional turmoil it brings as long-held secrets come to light.

title: Clannad: After Story
synopsis: Tomoya and Nagisa navigate adulthood together, deepening their bond as they confront personal struggles and build a future side by side.

title: Koe no Katachi
synopsis: Years after bullying a deaf classmate, Shouya Ishida seeks redemption by reconnecting with her and confronting the weight of his past.
